free_tier.stated: free to start with no credit card, on per-second CPU and memory billing with no minimums and no platform fee; a sandbox's rootfs is dropped on terminate

per_object_cap.stated: not stated in the source card
per_object_cap.notes: a sandbox has a disk ceiling rather than an object cap; the card does not carry it

retention.stated: not stated in the source card
retention.notes: durability of the sandbox disk on stop and on delete is not a field in either seed pass

egress.terms: Three per-sandbox network modes: off (default, no outbound), restricted (allowlist) and open (full egress, paid tier with verified billing); no egress allowance or overage price is published on the sandbox pages.

interface_detail: REST API at https://api.orkestr.eu/v1 with a Bearer token minted in the orkestr console, documented at orkestr.eu/docs/sandboxes/api-reference; Python and JS SDKs wrap it.
tooling: the orkestr Python SDK and JS SDK (docs at orkestr.eu/docs/sandboxes/python-sdk and /js-sdk), or the REST API directly from any language.
chaining: not established; the source card prices a machine, not a route into one
